checks.label: Intended tasks
checks.rule: Names concrete tasks the selected edition is intended to perform.

checks.label: Boundaries
checks.rule: States a limitation or condition under which this edition should not be used.

checks.label: Setup instructions
checks.rule: Provides a sequenced install or access route for this edition, not just a product announcement.

checks.label: Prerequisites
checks.rule: Identifies required host software or account prerequisites for this edition.

checks.label: Model requirements
checks.rule: Identifies the model/provider requirements or explains provider selection.

checks.label: Worked example
checks.rule: Shows a concrete request/workflow and describes the expected outcome.

checks.label: Tools and integrations
checks.rule: Identifies tools or integrations available to the selected edition.

checks.label: Permission description
checks.rule: Explains at least one permission boundary or approval behavior and its scope.

checks.label: Failure and recovery
checks.rule: Explains how to handle a concrete error, interruption or recovery case.

checks.label: Support route
checks.rule: Links a documented issue, support or troubleshooting route.

checks.label: License text
checks.rule: The reviewed source contains substantive license terms applying to this edition.

checks.label: Attribution
checks.rule: Reviewed source supplies copyright or attribution notices; presence is not a legal completeness opinion.

checks.label: Pinned source
checks.rule: Intake records an exact upstream commit and a verified file at that commit.

checks.label: Distribution relationship
checks.rule: Pinned source documents its official installation/distribution route for this edition; this does not prove binary equivalence.

checks.label: Dependency manifest
checks.rule: A reviewed manifest identifies the edition's runtime/build dependencies.

checks.label: Resolved dependencies
checks.rule: A reviewed lockfile or dependency inventory records exact resolved versions for this edition.

checks.label: Test sources
checks.rule: Reviewed source contains substantive tests for this edition. No execution or pass claim is awarded.

checks.label: CI definition
checks.rule: A reviewed CI definition invokes relevant checks. This does not establish that CI passed.

checks.label: Change history
checks.rule: A reviewed release/changelog document records concrete product changes.

checks.label: Security reporting
checks.rule: A reviewed policy specifies how to report a security concern. It is not a security assessment.

checks.label: Service terms
checks.rule: Official service terms identify conditions applying to this hosted edition.

checks.label: Pricing and usage units
checks.rule: Dated official documentation explains pricing/access and the unit of usage charged.

checks.label: Data retention
checks.rule: Official documentation states a retention period or retention/deletion policy for customer data.

checks.label: Training and data use
checks.rule: Official documentation states whether/how customer data is used for model training.

checks.label: Authentication
checks.rule: Official documentation identifies supported sign-in or account authentication controls.

checks.label: Permission controls
checks.rule: Official documentation explains scoped access restrictions or human approvals.

checks.label: Audit and export
checks.rule: Official documentation identifies available audit records or session-data export and access conditions.

checks.label: Deletion and revocation
checks.rule: Official documentation explains how to delete relevant data or revoke access.

checks.label: Service status
checks.rule: An official public status or incident page identifies this service.

checks.label: Product changes
checks.rule: An official changelog describes dated changes to this hosted service.
